value: Kil’jaeden is gone, yet corruption still clouds the Sunwell. Regent Lord Lor’themar considers destroying it lest the sickness spread beyond the fount. A victory has spared Quel’Thalas from one catastrophe, but the price may yet be the heart of the kingdom. Then Velen comes to honor M’uru.
editorNote: Lor’themar’s consideration is taken from the TBC episode account and needs direct game-text review. Do not frame the well as already purified at this point. Record remains research. Original-client and human source review are still required; no record is promoted to reviewed or published.
